title: PE Controls For Java
description: A minecraft mod to add minecraft pe style controls to troll your friends and use for other useful cases.
body:
PE Controls is a client-side Fabric mod that makes Java Edition controls feel closer to classic Minecraft PE/Bedrock touch-style aiming.

Instead of always targeting the center crosshair, PE Controls lets you use a free cursor to point at blocks and entities anywhere on the screen. It is designed for players who prefer cursor-based block interaction while keeping normal Java movement.

Features
Free PE-style cursor while the mod is enabled
Off-center block breaking and interaction
Survival block breaking with left-click hold
Single right-click to place blocks, open chests, and interact
Hold right-click and drag to rotate the camera
PE-style cursor dot and block-breaking progress ring
One simple keybind to toggle the mod on and off
Client-side only
Controls
P: Toggle PE Controls on/off
Left click: Break the block under the cursor
Hold left click: Continue breaking blocks in survival
Right click: Use, place, or interact with the target under the cursor
Hold right click and drag: Move the view
WASD, jump, sneak, scroll wheel: unchanged from vanilla
Requirements
Minecraft 1.20.1
Fabric Loader 0.15.7 or newer
Fabric API
Notes
This mod changes client-side camera and hit-target behavior. It is intended for normal gameplay, building, and PE-style control preference. Server-side installation is not required.
